title: [LOGGED OUT] "Referral program" panel opens with its texts and closes again
reason: Panel opened with all expected texts and closed with the X button

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown, clicked Dismiss, banner gone

steps.text: Is a white "Referral program" button shown at the bottom right?
steps.saw: White "Referral program" button at bottom right
Panel opened on the right side

steps.text: Does the panel show "get bonuses together!" and "Bring friends and enjoy bonuses when they make first purchases."?
steps.saw: Heading "Invite friends — get bonuses together!" and text "Bring friends and enjoy bonuses when they make first purchases. Your friends will also get rewards."

steps.text: Does it show "You will get:" "Emeralds x100, Gold x1000" and "Your friend will get:" "Emeralds x650, Gold x10000"?
steps.saw: "You will get:" Emeralds x100, Gold x1000 (x1); "Your friend will get:" Emeralds x650, Gold x10000 (x1)

steps.text: Are an "Invite friends" button and a "Log in to view rewards" button shown?
steps.saw: Both buttons visible: "Invite friends" and "Log in to view rewards" (under "My rewards")

steps.text: Click the X button at the bottom right (where the "Referral program" button was).
steps.saw: Clicked the X button; panel closed

steps.text: Is the panel closed and the "Referral program" button shown again?
steps.saw: Panel closed; white "Referral program" button back at bottom right
